page.title: Missions
page.subtitle: What is running today, and what is coming up for renewal. Sorted by urgency, not by creation date.
page.introSubtitle: Secure the starts, deadlines and renewals before they become urgent.

noEndDate: No end date — no renewal window can trigger on it.

finance.title: Commercial terms

finance.costHint: Entered by hand, deliberately. An average cost applied to everyone would produce a false margin — more dangerous than no margin at all.
finance.channelHint: Direct, through an intermediary, or our consultants lent out.
finance.noticeDaysHint: The notice period to give before ending the mission.
finance.requiresPoHint: The client will not pay an invoice without a purchase order. Once ticked, the month stays blocked for invoicing until the number is entered.
finance.commissionHint: The share the intermediary takes, per day worked. Left empty it is UNKNOWN, and so is the mission’s real cost — an intermediary does not work for free. Zero is an answer: a partner who takes nothing does exist.
finance.commissionStale: An intermediary commission of €{{value}} per day is still recorded on this mission, which did not go through an intermediary. It counts towards its real cost.

table.label: Timesheets
table.dialogIntro: Declared, reviewed internally, client approval: three distinct pieces of information. A correction after validation requires a reason and puts the validations back on hold.

after.chainBody1: Declared days, internal approval and client approval are distinct. A correction after approval needs a reason and puts approvals back on hold.
after.chainBody2: A source already invoiced stays frozen. Its correction goes through a corrective document, never an invisible rewrite.
after.nextBody: The file moves into preparation checks: rate, order, entity and proof. A missing cost is flagged for the margin, without becoming a zero cost.

collections.headline: Know what comes in. And what is waiting.

guide.heading: Knowing what is collected, expected or disputed
guide.intro: The client balance counts allocated payments, without mistaking a promise for money in.
guide.step1: Log the movement, then match it to the same client’s invoices.
guide.step2: Handle disputes and prepare the follow-ups to review.
guide.step3: Keep overpayments and unallocated sums as separate items.

scores.title: Risk & opportunity
scores.hint: Two scores and never one: “high risk, high opportunity” is a mission to work on urgently, “high risk, low opportunity” one to let go.
scores.noAccess: Risk and opportunity scores are outside your scope. This is not missing data: it is a permission your role does not have.
scores.notComputed: No score yet: fewer than three axes could be evaluated on this mission.

planning.title: Planning
planning.subtitle: Who is on which mission, and until when. An end we do not know is not drawn as an end.
planning.search: Search a mission, an account, a consultant…

summary.why: “No end date” is counted separately: those missions have no deadline to anticipate, and filing them with the end dates would invent one.

bar.openEnd: No end date — the right edge of the bar is not a deadline.
bar.openStart: No start date — the left edge of the bar is not a date.

undated.title: No usable date
undated.description: Neither a start nor an end. Putting them at the left of the timeline would give them a date nobody entered.

outside.title: Outside the window
outside.description_one: {{count}} mission is dated outside these months.
outside.description_other: {{count}} missions are dated outside these months.

inconsistent.title: Dates to fix
inconsistent.description: The end precedes the start. Nothing is drawn: a backwards bar cannot be seen, and says nothing.

planning.emptyTitle: Nothing to plan in these months
planning.emptyDescription: No mission covers this window. They ended before it, or have not started yet.
planning.searchEmptyDescription: The search covers the mission name, the account, the role and the people assigned. Nothing here says the window is empty — only that your search finds nothing.
planning.truncated: The mission read is capped at {{count}} rows, closest end dates first. Beyond that, a mission ending later may be missing from this timeline.
planning.introSubtitle: See which consultants are engaged, what starts next and who becomes available.

facetHints.starts: Missions whose start falls inside the window on screen.
facetHints.ends: Missions whose PLANNED end falls inside the window. A mission with no end date is never counted here.
facetHints.openEnded: Missions running with no known end. Their right edge is not a deadline.

availability.renewed: Renewed — no availability on this date
availability.declaredHint: Declared on their profile — it wins over the mission end

laura.label: Ask {{copilot}} about my schedule
laura.question: On my mission schedule from {{from}} to {{to}}{{filters}}: who frees up in the next 30 days, which missions have no end date, and where do I have a renewal risk?

blocked.description: Starts and renewals in the next 60 days whose file is incomplete. The reason is fixed in the mission file.
blocked.loadFailed: The start files could not be read. The list is not empty: it is unknown.
blocked.footnote: A reason at zero stays neutral: it is never painted green.

deadlines.title: Deadlines to prepare
deadlines.subtitle: The planning’s deadlines, not a second task manager.
deadlines.empty: No deadline to prepare in the next 30 days.
deadlines.intercontractHint: No mission in progress: offer one, or open an internal need.
deadlines.endingAction: Plan what comes next: renew, reposition the person or close cleanly.
deadlines.startingAction: Check the agreement, access and purchase order before day one.

legend.label: Planning legend
legend.endIsNotAvailability: Planned end ≠ confirmed availability. Moving a mission is validated before it is applied.

screen.title: Missions
screen.subtitle: Who is working, until when. And what to prepare next.
screen.featureText: People, deadlines and next steps in a single planning.

hint.ending: Missions whose planned end falls within the next 30 days. A missing end is never counted.
hint.ending60: Missions whose planned end falls within the next 60 days (the 30-day window included). A missing end is never counted.
hint.ending90: Missions whose planned end falls within the next 90 days (the 30- and 60-day windows included). A missing end is never counted.
hint.starting: Missions whose start is planned after today.
hint.noEnd: Missions running with no known end. Their right edge is not a deadline.
hint.toCheck: Missions with a planning conflict: overlap, gap, over-allocation, start without a consultant.

filters.title: Filter the planning
filters.intro: The same selection applies to the planning, the table and the board. Missions are neither deleted nor moved.

views.title: Planning views
views.intro: Save the filters and the date window, without copying the missions.

board.emptyColumns: Empty columns collapsed: {{list}}. Moving a card checks its prerequisites first.

intro.choose: Start from a won deal, a document or a short entry. No mission is created before review.
intro.manual: Account, person, dates and terms. The rest can be completed later.
intro.document: Pick the account, then drop the contract or purchase order: the fields read are proposed to you.
intro.odoo: Confirmed sales that do not have a mission yet: import them one by one, or all after review.

manual.title: Enter the mission
manual.hint: Account, person, dates and terms. The rest can be completed later.

document.title: From a document
document.hint: Attach the contract or purchase order, then check the fields read.

won.title: From a won deal
won.hint: Find the linked mission, or open the existing Deals flow.

odoo.title: Import from your management tool
odoo.hint: Your tool is connected: some confirmed sales have no mission yet. Import one by one, or all after review.

peek.afterFromUncertain: After the mission: available on {{date}}, subject to what follows. A planned end is not a confirmed availability.
peek.afterNow: After the mission: nothing is committed.
peek.afterUnknown: No end entered: no availability is assumed.

move.title: Move the mission
move.intro: A move is validated: the assignment, timesheets and purchase order are reviewed before being changed.
move.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start.
move.availabilityNote: A planned end is not a confirmed availability: if the person declared one, review it with them.

signedProjects.subtitle: A signed project is tracked here instead of a mission: there is no consultant to staff.
signedProjects.detailDescription: Follow-up of the signed project: steps, deliverables and dates.

chain.title: From signature to cash
chain.intro: The five steps of this mission, and the screen where each one is fixed.

why.readingFailed: The month could not be read: this step is not measured — that does not make it cleared.
why.noRowThisMonth: No billing line for this mission on the month read.
why.notMonthly: This mission is not billed monthly: the question does not arise.
why.craBlockedWithoutCode: The timesheet is blocking with no recorded reason — the timesheets screen says which.
why.waitingOnTimesheet: Nothing blocks here: it is the timesheet, at the previous step.
why.readyToInvoice: Ready to invoice — no invoice recorded yet.
why.waitingOnBillable: The month is not billable yet.
why.disputed: The client is disputing this invoice: reminders are stopped.
why.overdue: The due date has passed and no payment is recorded.
why.notInvoicedYet: Nothing to collect: the invoice has not gone out.
why.noRenewalWindow: This mission's deadline was not sent — worth checking again in a moment.
why.noEndDate: This mission has no end date: there is no way to say when to reposition.
why.tooEarly: The end of the mission is still far off.

window.j60: The end is coming: two months.
window.j45: The end is coming: six weeks.
window.j30: The end is coming: one month.
window.j15: The end is coming: fifteen days.

why.missionNotRead: The mission’s status was not sent — check again in a moment.
why.onboarding: The mission is being set up: it has not started yet.
why.notStartedYet: The mission has not started yet.
why.paused: The mission is paused: its billing stops with it.
why.periodRunning: The period is still running: this step comes when it ends.
why.waitingOnSubmission: The timesheet is not submitted yet: nothing to approve.
why.sendNotTracked: {{brand}} prepares the invoice, it does not send it: sending is checked in the invoicing tool.
why.noDueDate: No due date is set: impossible to say whether it has passed.
why.dueLater: The due date is ahead: this delay is contractual, not late.
why.partialPayment: A partial payment is recorded: the rest is still owed.
why.noReconciliation: {{brand}} reconciles no bank account: reconciliation is checked in the accounting tool.
why.notPaidYet: Nothing to reconcile or close until the balance is collected.

chain.noDoor: No screen to open from this step.

missing.mission_owner: No owner on this mission — step without an owner
missing.consultant: No consultant assigned — step without an owner

proof.invoicedProven: Invoice read from the connected tool on {{date}}

timeline.noCurrent: No open step on the month read.

noGo.title: Inconsistent step
noGo.openWithoutOwner: {{stage}}: open without an owner or an exception.

askLaura.label: Ask {{copilot}}
askLaura.question: What should I know or do about the mission "{{mission}}" ({{account}})?

planPoint.label: Plan a check-in
planPoint.question: Prepare a check-in for the mission "{{mission}}" ({{account}}). Tell me what changed since last time and what still needs to be decided.

createAction.label: Create an action
createAction.defaultReason: Keep {{mission}} under control and spot what needs handling
createAction.defaultExpectedOutcome: {{mission}} tracked: every point to handle is spotted and dated
createAction.created: Action added to the account plan.
createAction.createError: The action could not be created.

dossier.errorTitle: This mission could not be loaded
dossier.errorBody: It is still there — the read is what failed. Try again.
dossier.missingBody: This mission is not in this workspace. The link may come from another workspace, or the mission has since been removed.

primaryAction.pointer_one: {{count}} item to complete — the detail is in the checklist just below.
primaryAction.pointer_other: {{count}} items to complete — the detail is in the checklist just below.
primaryAction.label: Primary action

reasons.ending_confirmed: Ending confirmed or repositioning already launched — nothing starts on its own.
reasons.market_demand: Market demand is measured on an assignee’s territory.
reasons.profile_scarcity: A rare profile is harder to reposition.
reasons.open_needs: An open need requires a skill an assignee holds.
reasons.partners: A partner is already known on the client account.
reasons.relations: A declared relation already exists on the client account.
reasons.constraints: An assignee has declared a constraint on their profile.
reasons.market_memory: The market shows a technology at the client that an assignee holds.
reasons.presentation_history: An assignee was recently presented, across any need — the profile is already circulating in the market.

relief.hint: Prepare continuity without changing the current assignment.
relief.title: Mission follow-up — {{mission}}
relief.context: Prepare what follows “{{mission}}”: a relief or a reinforcement. The current assignment is not changed; the need created is compared with the talent pool.

props.label: Mission properties
props.lauraQuestion: What should I know or prepare about the mission “{{mission}}” ({{account}})?

pointClient.title: Prepare the client review
pointClient.intro: Preparing sends nothing: the draft is kept in your mailbox, you review it and send it yourself.
pointClient.subject: Subject
pointClient.kept: Draft kept in your mailbox. Nothing is sent.
pointClient.keepError: The draft could not be kept.
pointClient.noRecipient: No client contact is set on this mission: set one to leave a draft.
pointClient.noEmail: The contact’s e-mail address is not filled in: the text stays copyable, no address is guessed.

createMission.title: New mission
createMission.description: An account, a title, a start date: the mission is created and follows its lifecycle (ongoing, extended, ended).

noEndDateConsequence: Without it, no renewal can be triggered in time.

facetHints.toRenew: Overdue, imminent, or ending within 30 days
facetHints.noEndDate: No renewal window can be triggered without it
facetHints.withRisk: At least one computed risk — renewal not started, timesheet, margin
facetHints.marginAtRisk: Margin is negative or zero — not just unmeasured
facetHints.consultantsSoonAvailable: Confirmed end or repositioning already launched within 30 days — never a renewal that's only been announced

toolbar.filteredDescription: Your search or your chips let nothing through. The counters still count the whole list.

meetingPrep.title: Prepare the meeting
meetingPrep.subtitle: Pitch, first-meeting (R1) flow and references: ready to read before you call the client.

startReadiness.title: What is blocking the start
startReadiness.saveError: The prerequisite could not be saved.

endChecklist.title: Exit checklist
endChecklist.saveError: The item could not be saved.

deliveryMilestones.title: Delivery milestones
deliveryMilestones.saveError: The milestone could not be saved.

endReason.title: End reason
endReason.saveError: The end reason could not be saved.

interruption.title: Mission interrupted
interruption.availabilityPending: Availability not confirmed — a second, separate action is required before the consultant can be proposed elsewhere.
interruption.saveError: The interruption could not be saved.

savedViews.title: My views
savedViews.loadError: I couldn’t load your saved views.
savedViews.empty: No saved view yet. Set some filters, then save them.
savedViews.locked: Saved views aren’t opened by your plan.
savedViews.noCriteria: Set at least one filter: a view with no criteria is the full list, it already exists.
savedViews.full: You already have {{max}} views on this screen — beyond that, you stop choosing. Remove one.

businessUnit.dialogTitle: Transfer the mission to another BU
businessUnit.dialogHint: The mission changes owning BU within your workspace. The transfer is logged (who, when, source BU → target BU) in the mission’s History; nothing is deleted.
businessUnit.noTarget: There is no other active BU in your workspace to transfer this mission to.
businessUnit.confirm: I confirm the transfer of this mission
businessUnit.transferFailed: The transfer could not be completed.

monthPrep.title: Prepare the invoice for {{month}}
monthPrep.unavailable: Nothing to prepare for this month, or billing is not available with your role.
monthPrep.alreadyInvoiced: This month is already declared invoiced: nothing left to prepare.
monthPrep.noPrevious: No invoice from the previous month to carry over — client: {{client}}

alerts.po_missing: No purchase order entered although the client requires one.
alerts.po_expired: The purchase order expired on {{until}}: it does not cover this month.
alerts.po_ends_mid_period: The purchase order ends on {{until}}, before the end of this month.
alerts.po_not_started: The purchase order only starts on {{from}}: it does not cover this month.
alerts.po_volume_exceeded: Cumulated days exceed the purchase order volume by {{exceeded}} d.

monthPrep.preparedNotSent: Prepared — not yet created or sent
monthPrep.noWriteRight: Preparing an invoice requires finance write access.
monthPrep.saveError: The preparation could not be saved.
monthPrep.autoHint: On the first working day, the past month is prepared. Nothing is created in the connected tool or sent: you keep that step.

createForm.label: Title
createForm.endBeforeStart: The end cannot be before the start.

client.title: For which client
client.lede: The account carries the mission; the signed deal links it to its pipeline.

mission.title: What starts, and when
mission.lede: A title the team recognises, a start date. The end can wait.

conditions.title: The rate and the person
conditions.lede: Optional at creation: you complete them in the record.

lifecycle.extendDescription: An "end date change" amendment is recorded in the history; the consultant’s availability moves to the next day.
lifecycle.newDailyRate: New daily rate (€), if it changes
lifecycle.endDescription: The mission becomes "completed"; the consultant is available again the day after the end.
lifecycle.keptHuman: {{count}} consultant record(s) keep a hand-entered availability.

engagement.conflict: The record says "{{availability}}" (entered {{date}}); the mission "{{mission}}" says on mission.

after.title: After the mission
after.distinct: The planning date and the consultant's availability are two distinct pieces of information.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.hint: Prepared here, created in your tool

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.banner: Invoices, from preparation to settlement. {{brand}} prepares the document: it neither issues nor books it — the legal number and credit notes come from the connected tool.

tiles.unknown: amount not measured on these documents
tiles.issuedNoteDeclared: Read from your tool · of which {{value}} declared without proof
tiles.label: Invoice figures

invoices.empty: No invoice prepared or issued in this window.
invoices.filteredEmpty: No document has this state in this selection.

frozen.title: Document frozen once created
frozen.body: Creating it in your invoicing tool freezes the lines, VAT and references. Changing the mission rate does not recompute an older invoice.
frozen.correction: A correction goes through a corrective invoice linked to the original one, in your tool; {{brand}} reads and shows it. Preparations stay revisable until they are created.

accounting.title: Connected invoicing tool
accounting.body: Reads invoices, corrective invoices and numbers. {{brand}} tracks invoicing; it keeps no chart of accounts, entries or journal.
accounting.none: No invoicing tool is connected: “invoiced” can then only be declared, without proof.

invoices.headline: Invoices, from preparation to settlement.
invoices.lede: Invoices tied to missions. {{brand}} prepares them; your invoicing tool creates and numbers them. Corrections adjust a document; they are not collections.

guide.heading: Telling prepared, created and sent apart
guide.intro: {{brand}} prepares the invoice from validated activity: days, rate and references. Your invoicing tool creates it, numbers it and sends it when you decide.
guide.step1: Check the detail and the sources.
guide.step2: Refresh a preparation if the activity changed.
guide.step3: Once created, correct it with an adjustment made in your tool rather than a silent edit.
guide.keep: “Invoiced” always shows its source: a reading of your invoicing tool, or an unconfirmed declaration.

lifecycle.label: The three stages of an invoice
lifecycle.createdNote: In your invoicing tool, which numbers it
lifecycle.sentNote: By your tool, when you decide

dialog.sourceReadBody: Number, lines and adjustments come from your tool: {{brand}} reads them, it does not rewrite them.
dialog.draftWarning: Prepared: not a receivable, not a collection. The mission rate can still move it until it is created in your tool.

due.title: Enter the due date · {{label}}
due.body: Without a due date, this invoice falls into no overdue bucket: it is named apart (“No due date”), never counted as “on time”.
due.readOnly: This invoice is read from your invoicing tool: its due date is corrected there, or from the month’s billing — never rewritten here.

financeView.title: Revenue, margin and cash
financeView.lede: A financial reading tied to missions, with the unknowns and the documents to handle. It is not a general ledger.
financeView.statusFailed: Your Finance permission could not be checked. Try again in a moment.

denied.title: The financial view requires the Finance permission
denied.body: Margins, costs and payments stay confidential. The workspace administrator can open it for you.

outgoing.title: What goes out: payments and assignments
outgoing.body: Payments to consultants and subcontractors are followed here, with receivable assignments.

expenses.title: Mission expenses
expenses.body: Expenses are entered and approved in expense reports; the scale sets what can be re-invoiced.
expenses.empty: No expense report in this period.

financeView.atCompletion: Margin at completion and contribution after internal allocations are read in each mission’s file.

guide.heading: Reading production, margin and cash separately
guide.intro: The financial view helps settle blockers, documented profitability and expected payments.
guide.step1: Pick the activity period, then the scope of missions.
guide.step2: Open the documents that explain an amount or a gap.
guide.step3: Follow what goes out and what comes in on their own screens.
guide.keep: Mission margin and due-date forecast are neither net income nor a bank balance. Unknown costs stay unknown.

stats.invoicedNote: What went out to the invoicing tool
stats.outstandingNote: Balance, all periods, after allocated payments
stats.label: The period’s figures

margin.unmeasured: no mission with known activity and cost
margin.coverage: Over {{measured}} measured missions · {{unmeasured}} without a known cost. Unknown costs are not zero.
margin.warning: Contribution margin, not net income. Overheads, payroll, bank, VAT due and accounting are not reconstructed.

decisions.title: What deserves a decision
decisions.activityBody: Timesheets to validate and files to unblock

weeks.title: The next four weeks
weeks.hint: Payment forecast based on due dates. Not a bank balance.
weeks.unplaced_one: {{count}} invoice to reschedule, disputed or without a due date ({{value}}), not placed arbitrarily in a week.
weeks.unplaced_other: {{count}} invoices to reschedule, disputed or without a due date ({{value}}), not placed arbitrarily in a week.
weeks.unplacedUnknown_one: {{count}} invoice to reschedule, disputed or without a due date, not placed in a week.
weeks.unplacedUnknown_other: {{count}} invoices to reschedule, disputed or without a due date, not placed in a week.
weeks.aging: See the aging of the outstanding

byMission.title: Profitability, mission by mission
byMission.costUnknown: no cost documented in the mission terms

aging.body: What is still due, sorted by due-date age, lives in Collections — with the actions to handle it.

suppliers.title: Purchases and supplier invoices
suppliers.where: Documents are kept on each mission
suppliers.body: Supplier invoices are filed and checked on each mission’s file, against its activity report; the resulting payment is tracked just below, in “What goes out”.

presetViews.title: Ready-made views
presetViews.hint: A named population in one click — click again to clear it.
